correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all homomorphisms on the generators of (F_q,+)⋊C_m: the unique Sylow p-subgroup is preserved, irreducibility makes each nonzero kernel map bijective, and the Frobenius-power intertwiner gives all automorphisms. The singular maps ρ_(c,j) have exact unique labels for j nonzero and multiply by ρ_(c,j)ρ_(d,k)=ρ_(c,jk). CRT gives the Boolean idempotents. The symmetric commutation equation, maximality via disjoint unions of occupied supports, inverse coloring map, size distribution, q^r identity and centralizer formula have been recomputed algebraically. Direct independent enumeration at (q,m)=(7,6),(4,3) and idempotent checks at (16,15) pass; those finite experiments are not the infinite proof. The known automorphism description agrees with Wang (2016), Theorem 1.1, in the irreducible scalar case.

originality.rationale: The same objects/parameters and plausible broader implications were checked by actual semantic records, accessible prior claims, relevant full primary mathematical texts, and exact computation comparisons. The known End(T_n) band is a different endomorphism monoid; known interchange-ring pairs on abelian groups do not imply the r-prime colored Boolean classification; the same scalar Frobenius group in published work was studied through character codegrees rather than endomorphism composition. No inspected result implies the claimed q^r maximal-family count or complete size polynomial; priority remains an unresolved literature-wide risk. Wang’s Frobenius automorphism classification is credited as known and does not reach singular endomorphisms.
residual_risks: An unindexed general theory of retraction bands of Frobenius groups or group endomorphism monoids might state equivalent structural results.
A general graph-clique theorem for labelled powerset bands could imply the combinatorial classification after the band product is known.
One external study of general endomorphism monoids beyond the inspected sources might imply a stronger result; claims are relative to inspected sources, not a priority certificate.

value.rationale: This is an exact complete classification of maximal compatible group retraction systems in a natural infinite nonabelian Frobenius family with composite complement, not a tiny table or arbitrary slice. It exhibits how distinct prime-power factors of the complement can be assigned independently to noncommuting complements, gives the unexpected q^ω(m) count, a full maximal-family-size distribution and a conjugacy-independent commuting centralizer spectrum. These are natural semigroup-theoretic invariants, with fixed q,m specialization and structural information beyond separate idempotent counts.
